run_simfinger_torque_control_demo: run the trifinger simulation demo with constant torque control and periodic direction reversal
create_simfinger_instance: create a SimFinger instance with finger_type fingerone and enable_visualization set to True
create_simfinger_action: create a SimFinger Action with a numpy torque array for joint control
append_desired_action: append a desired torque action to the simulation and retrieve the current timestep
get_observation_at_timestep: get the simulation observation at a specific timestep returned by append_desired_action
